G-B12 ensemble voting REJECTED: on 115 clean-GT pages full ROVER union median CER 3.921, agreement(>=3 families) 0.8973, skeleton 0.7671, best-single oracle 0.6278; full ensemble beats all singles on 0/115 and is worse than worst single on 115/115.

Ensemble failure mechanism = line-segmentation granularity mismatch (te_001 surya 15 lines vs tesseract 32 vs paddle 46; kn_014 surya 3 mega-lines vs doctr 44); Jaccard-5 line clustering cannot align. Region-level voting (Q-B12.1) untested.

Poisoned-GT census: 52 of 115 'clean' PDF-text-layer pages (45%) are legacy-font mojibake (>=5% Latin-1 symbols; e.g. te_022, ml_028, kn_026); engines reading correctly get CER 0.85-1.0, so CER ranking is inverted on ~45% of basis. FFFD/PUA<0.5% filter misses it.

On non-mojibake 63 pages best-single median CER 0.306, agreement 0.645; precision advantage of agreement evaporates (0.741 vs 0.747) - was engines agreeing against broken GT. C2 (P0) successor gate: rerun clean-GT recompute with legacy-font detector.
